Class GameLogic

java.lang.Object
game.logic.GameLogic
public class GameLogic extends Object
The core controller and engine for the active game.

This class governs the main gameplay loop, manages all active entities (enemies and towers), handles the game economy (money, lives, wave progression), and validates player actions such as tower placement and upgrades. It communicates heavily with GameView to ensure the UI accurately reflects the internal state.

    • canUpgrade

      public boolean canUpgrade(Tower tower, int path)
      Checks if the player meets all requirements to purchase the next tier on a specific upgrade path for a given tower.

      Enforces the 4-2 upgrade rule: A tower can only max out one path (Tier 4), restricting the secondary path to Tier 2.

      Parameters:
      tower - The Tower being evaluated.
      path - The upgrade path index (0 or 1).
      Returns:
      true if the upgrade is allowed and affordable.

    • isPathLocked

      public boolean isPathLocked(Tower tower, int path)

      Parameters:

      path - The upgrade path index (0 or 1).
      Returns:
      true if the path is locked.

    • checkPlacementValid

      public boolean checkPlacementValid(double x, double y)
      Validates whether a specific coordinate is a legal location to place a new tower.

      Checks that the new tower would not overlap excessively with existing towers and that it is not placed directly on the enemy track.

      Parameters:
      x - The proposed X coordinate.
      y - The proposed Y coordinate.
      Returns:
      true if the location is valid.
